description.value:
Shoots off fiercely and rapidly, just like an old BARGHEST flame. Besides, arms and legs… who needs ‘em? Well, except for you, ‘cuz this hungry hound will keep you running.

Category: Very Expensive • Fabrication: DV24 - 1,000eb - 2 Weeks

Class: Iconic Assault Rifle • Skill: Shoulder Arms • Range: Carbine

Damage: 4d6 • Capacity: 40 • ROF: 1 • Hands: 2

Alt. Firing Modes: Autofire (Machine Pistol 4), Suppressive Fire

Concealable: No

Slots: 1 • Attachments: Power Rebuild • Mods: None

Special Features: Can only load Armor-Piercing Ammunition, which for this weapon costs the same as Basic Ammunition. Ammunition purchased for this weapon can only be used by this weapon. If this weapon’s user has moved at least 8m/yds on foot in their Turn, they gain a +1 bonus to Attack Checks with this weapon until the end of their Turn. If this weapon’s user has moved at least 16m/yds on foot during their Turn, this weapon deals 1d6 additional damage (5d6) in Single Shot and its user gains an additional +2 bonus to Attack Checks with this weapon until the end of their Turn.

Fabrication: DV24 - 1,000eb - 2 Weeks
Range: Carbine
Pre-installed: Power Rebuild (effects already included in these stats)
Alt. fire: Autofire (Machine Pistol 4), Suppressive Fire

Foundry notes:

  • Its range tables come from this module's DV Tables compendium; run the module's "Use Corgo's 77 DV Tables" macro once per world (see the module README).
  • Iconic weapons follow the Exotic weapon rules: no Non-Basic Ammunition and no Attachment Slots unless this entry says otherwise.
  • Iconic: it can't be bought or sourced on the street, can't be fabricated without its Blueprint, can't be taken during Character Generation, and once acquired can't be destroyed unless the player agrees to it beforehand.
  • The price is the Very Expensive benchmark, for working out repairs and Tech Upgrades. Iconics can't be bought.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Becoming Iconic > Iconic Weapons).
